title: Zone shift pair
statement: For a zone configuration and a natural-number index $i$, the zone-step operation first shifts into zone $i$ in the rightward direction and then shifts out of zone $i$ in the leftward direction.
caveat: The definitions of the shift-in and shift-out operations are not included, so their precise effects cannot be stated.
